message.content: {"label":"sufficient","reason":"Three explicit risk examples are provided in the Risk Factors Summary: the COVID-19 pandemic impact, historical net losses/profitability concerns, and laws/regulations affecting short-term rentals. All three are directly supported by the passages.","supported_requirements":[{"requirement":"COVID-19 pandemic impact on business, results of operations, and financial condition","passage_rank":1,"quote":"The COVID-19 pandemic and the impact of actions to mitigate the COVID-19 pandemic have materially adversely impacted and will continue to materially adversely impact our business, results of operations, and financial condition."},{"requirement":"Historical net losses and uncertainty about achieving profitability","passage_rank":1,"quote":"We have incurred net losses in each year since inception, and we may not be able to achieve profitability. We incurred net losses of $70.0 million, $16.9 million, $674.3 million, and $696.9 million for the years ended December 31, 2017, 2018, and 2019, and nine months ended September 30, 2020, respectively."},{"requirement":"Laws/regulations affecting short-term rentals that could limit business","passage_rank":1,"quote":"Laws, regulations, and rules that affect the short-term rental and home sharing business may limit the ability or willingness of hosts to share their spaces over our platform and expose our hosts or us to significant penalties, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations, and financial condition."}],"missing_requirements":[],"concerns":[]}
